candidates.change_summary: Replace the overflow-safe require with a stricter require that enforces depositsCount to strictly increase (prevents no-op), causing revert if depositsCount would not increase.
Remove the require check entirely so receive always increments depositsCount on any payable call.
Add a revert condition that forbids depositsCount from increasing beyond 0 (reverts when depositsCount would become 1 or higher).
Change the increment to a decrement so receive decreases depositsCount instead of increasing it.
Increment depositsCount by 2 instead of 1, changing the observed value after receive.
Move the require after the increment so the increment can occur before the check (possible revert after state change).
Add an additional increment so depositsCount increases twice on each receive call.
Replace the single call inside withdrawAll to call withdraw with zero value instead of the contract balance, so withdrawAll sends 0 instead of full balance.
Modify the onlyOwner modifier to require the caller is NOT the owner, inverting the guard so withdrawAll becomes callable by non-owners.
Change transfer target from msg.sender to owner so withdraw sends funds to the stored owner address instead of the transaction caller.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call withdraw and receive transferred funds to msg.sender.
Invert the onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT the owner, allowing only non-owners to pass the modifier; this changes who can call withdraw and thus alters post-withdraw recipient behavior.
